workflow.preserve: Keep the task, frozen inputs and existing resources. Do not submit a duplicate deployment or remove uncertain resources.
workflow.inspect: Restore access to the original Engine or a verified Manager of the same Swarm cluster. Fresh inspection is recorded separately from recovery.
workflow.review: Before releasing an uncertain Application task, stop Controllers and follow the documented runtime reconciliation review. Configuration, secret and volume effects require a separate operator decision; inspection alone never authorizes replay.
workflow.wait: Restore the verified executor, management permission and required quorum. The retained task can resume automatically if Docker has not accepted a write.
